safety.text: Many plants can strengthen or weaken the effect of medication, and some are not suitable during pregnancy or with certain conditions. That is why every article in the encyclopedia has a dedicated safety section.

about.hero_subtitle: Shafransa is the world’s first clinical-grade botanical ecosystem, merging ancient Caucasian wisdom with advanced neural analytics.
about.story_p1: Founded in the heart of the Caucasus, Shafransa was born from a simple observation: the world of herbal medicine lacked the transparency and scientific rigor of modern pharmaceuticals.
about.story_p2: We set out to change that by building a platform that doesn’t just sell herbs, but provides a verified, data-driven path to wellness.
about.mission_desc: To democratize access to lab-verified botanical medicine through artificial intelligence.
about.vision_desc: A world where every botanical intervention is as precise and safe as molecular medicine.
about.pillars_subtitle: Our methodology is built on a foundation of trust, science, and absolute transparency.
about.pillar1_desc: Every batch of herbs on our marketplace undergoes 3rd party lab testing for heavy metals, pesticides, and microbial contamination.
about.pillar2_desc: Our proprietary Shafransa AI Core™ analyzes thousands of clinical trials to provide evidence-based interaction checks and dosages.
about.pillar3_desc: We work directly with traditional Caucasian harvesters, ensuring fair wages and sustainable wild-crafting practices.

contact.hero_subtitle: Have a question about a botanical protocol or an order? Our team of specialists is here to provide clinical-grade support.

contact.wa_desc: Chat directly with our botanical specialists via WhatsApp for real-time guidance.

how_it_works.hero_title: A Simple Path to Personalized Wellness.
how_it_works.hero_subtitle: We’ve removed the guesswork from herbal medicine. Our four-step process ensures every botanical you take is safe, effective, and tailored exactly to your body.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Tell us about your health goals, current supplements, and wellness history. We listen to the details that matter.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Our system cross-references your profile with clinical research to find the safest, most effective botanical matches.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Order directly from our verified growers. Every product is lab-tested and certified before it ever reaches you.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Receive clear dosages and timing instructions. Your journey is monitored and adjusted as your health evolves.
how_it_works.safety_desc: We don’t just match herbs to symptoms. We cross-reference your entire health profile against known drug-herb interactions.
how_it_works.logistics_desc: Track your herbs from the exact farm in the Caucasus to your doorstep. Full transparency on drying and extraction methods.
how_it_works.human_p1: Generic wellness advice can be risky. We believe that botanical medicine should be as rigorous as anything you’d find in a clinic, but accessible from your home.
how_it_works.human_p2: Our team of researchers and pharmacists constantly update our database to ensure you are receiving the most current, science-backed guidance available.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data Shafransa collects, how it is used and what rights you have.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we collect when you use the Shafransa website and services, why we use it and who we share it with.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Account data: first and last name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only in a one-way hashed form. A profile photo and description are optional.
Order data: the name, phone number, address and note you provide for delivery, and the products ordered.
Session data: the therapist you choose, the date, time and format of the session, the note you add when booking, and any rating and review you leave afterwards.
Therapist data: phone number, licence number, specialisation, biography, prices, CV, certificates and working hours.
Activity data: product reviews, your cart and your saved items.
Technical data: for security purposes, server logs may record information such as your IP address and the time of a request.

sections.title: How we use information
paragraphs: We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it to third parties. The site has no advertising or analytics trackers.
items: To create your account, verify your email and let you sign in.
To accept and deliver your orders.
To arrange therapy sessions and send notifications about them.
To review therapist applications and show approved profiles on the site.
To protect accounts and the platform from abuse.

sections.title: Who we share information with
items: Therapists: for a session you book, the therapist sees your name, email and note.
Service providers: email notifications are sent through an email service, and uploaded images and documents are kept with a file storage service.
Video calls: online sessions run on Jitsi Meet (meet.jit.si), and Jitsi's privacy policy applies to the call.
Public authorities: only where the law requires it.

sections.title: Information stored in your browser
paragraphs: We do not use cookies. Your browser's local storage holds only your sign-in session, chosen language, display preference and saved items. The session is removed when you sign out.

sections.title: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is active. When an account is deleted, profile data, reviews, cart and saved items are deleted. Order records may be kept to meet accounting and legal obligations. Past sessions remain in the history without your name.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Passwords are stored in hashed form, data is sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and only authorised staff can access the admin panel. No system is completely secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your data.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can view and correct your data on your profile page. To have your account and data deleted, or to request a copy of the data we hold, write to us.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Our services are intended for adults. People under 18 may use the site only with the consent of a parent or guardian.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date of the latest update is shown at the top of the page. We give advance notice of significant changes on the site.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The rules for using the Shafransa website and services.
terms.intro: These terms set out the rules for using the Shafransa website and services. By using the site, you accept these terms.

sections.title: Services
paragraphs: Shafransa offers a plant encyclopedia, a shop for natural products, online and in-person sessions with phytotherapists, and an AI assistant. The range of services may change over time.

sections.title: About medical information
paragraphs: Information on the site, including answers from the AI assistant, is for educational purposes and does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you take medication, are pregnant or have a chronic condition, talk to your doctor before starting any herbal remedy. In an emergency, call 103.

sections.title: Your account
items: You must provide accurate information when signing up.
Do not share your password with anyone; you are responsible for activity on your account.
Accounts that break these terms may be blocked or deleted.

sections.title: Orders and payment
items: Prices are shown in the currency displayed on the site, as stated on each product page.
At the moment, payment is made in cash on delivery.
Orders depend on stock availability. If a product runs out, we will contact you.
For returns and exchanges, please write to us.

sections.title: Therapy sessions
items: Sessions are booked at least 24 hours in advance and are confirmed or declined by the therapist.
Online sessions take place in the browser via Jitsi Meet. The video link appears in your account once the therapist confirms.
The platform may cancel a session when necessary; both parties are notified by email.
Therapists are independent licensed professionals and are responsible for the services they provide. Shafransa helps arrange the appointment.

sections.title: For therapists
items: The information, licence and certificates in your profile must be accurate.
Applications are reviewed by our team; a profile appears on the site only after approval.
If these terms are broken, the profile may be hidden from the site or the account blocked.

sections.title: User content
paragraphs: Reviews and ratings should reflect your own experience. Offensive, misleading or promotional content may be removed without notice.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The text, design and logo on the site belong to Shafransa. They may not be copied or distributed for commercial purposes without written permission.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: We work to keep information accurate and up to date, but we do not guarantee that it is complete or error-free. To the extent permitted by law, Shafransa is not liable for indirect loss arising from the use of information on the site.

sections.title: Changes and governing law
paragraphs: These terms may be updated; the date of the latest update is shown at the top of the page. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
